name: Super Mario 3D All-Stars: Super Mario Sunshine

achievements.name: FLUDD Equipped
achievements.detail: Wash the paint off Delfino Airstrip and finish the opening course that leaves Mario with FLUDD.

achievements.name: Plaza Shine
achievements.detail: Scrub the goop in Delfino Plaza and collect a Shine Sprite in the hub.

achievements.name: Extra Nozzle
achievements.detail: Unlock a FLUDD nozzle beyond the starter spray, such as hover, rocket, or turbo.

achievements.name: Yoshi Ride
achievements.detail: Hatch Yoshi and ride him on a course that needs his juice spray.

achievements.name: Blue Coin Trade
achievements.detail: Trade ten Blue Coins at the Delfino Plaza boathouse for a Shine Sprite.

achievements.name: Hundred Coins
achievements.detail: Collect 100 coins in one visit to a course and take the Shine Sprite that appears.

achievements.name: Shadow Chase
achievements.detail: Catch the graffiti artist in a course chase and take the Shine Sprite from that pursuit.

achievements.name: Secret Course
achievements.detail: Clear a secret course after FLUDD is taken, reaching the Shine Sprite by jumping.

achievements.name: Red Coins
achievements.detail: On a return to a secret course, pound the red switch and collect all eight red coins in time.

achievements.name: Boss Shine
achievements.detail: Defeat a course boss such as Petey Piranha and claim the Shine Sprite from the fight.

achievements.name: Corona Mountain
achievements.detail: Clear the Shadow Mario episodes that open the flooded cave, then climb Corona Mountain for its Shine Sprite.

achievements.name: Every Shine
achievements.detail: Collect all 120 Shine Sprites and bring the sunlight back to Isle Delfino.
